## Flagship projects (measured, with limits stated)

- LedgerLens (https://ledgerlens.nknext.dev): double-entry ledger plus cited document-intelligence chat. 102 SEC advisory contracts indexed; median cost $0.0093 per answer (prompt 24k to 4.4k tokens); 277-case eval 79.4% correct (95% CI 72.8-84.8), citation recall 94.8%, measured at a stricter threshold than deployed, single run; load figures are local with a mocked provider.
- MediCoord AI (https://medicoord.nknext.dev/): LLM triage with deterministic facility selection. About 35 messages/s per server on a 1 vCPU staging box with a mock provider calibrated against real calls; 93,322-message soak, 0 failed; the 1,000+ concurrent target was not reached.
